title: How to Build a Promo Video + Ready‑to‑Use GIFs, Clips & Images

scenes.narration: First, define your goal and sketch a quick storyboard so every second counts.
scenes.prompt: A bright modern workspace with a laptop open to a storyboard template, sticky notes with sketches, a coffee mug, and a digital timer, viewed from slightly above, vibrant colors, clean style
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom in on the storyboard area

scenes.narration: Next, gather or shoot footage, then pull out key moments to turn into eye‑catching GIFs and a bold still image that matches your brand.
scenes.prompt: A split‑screen: left side shows a camera on a tripod filming a product, right side shows a computer screen with a timeline where a short clip is being selected and exported as a looping GIF, crisp digital art style
scenes.motion_direction: pan left to right across the split‑screen

scenes.narration: Finally, edit the clip to a vertical 9:16 format, add captions, export for Facebook Reels and YouTube Shorts, and save the GIFs and thumbnail for cross‑platform promotion.
scenes.prompt: A vertical video editing interface on a monitor, showing a 9:16 timeline, caption overlay, export button highlighted, alongside small icons for Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts, and a thumbnail preview, sleek UI design
scenes.motion_direction: fade transition into a quick scroll of the export options
